title: At Risk table revenue link opens the Sales report with the same total
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • The At Risk Customers tile's window pill reads 120 Days (the default).
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Risk Fleet) is in the At Risk Customers table with a Revenue (12 Mo) above $0.00 (for example $1,250.00).
  • Customer {Customer-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Old Fleet) is in the same table with a Revenue (12 Mo) of $0.00.
  • The table may also show a walk-in row (sales with no customer); the check of that row is recorded as not reachable if there is none.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click View details on At Risk Customers.
  3. Write down {Customer-A}'s Revenue (12 Mo).
  4. Click {Customer-A}'s Revenue (12 Mo) amount.
  5. Read the Sales report's customer filter, its dates and its Totals row Subtotal.
  6. Go back to the Dashboard and click View details on At Risk Customers.
  7. Point at {Customer-B}'s $0.00 amount, then click it.
  8. Point at the walk-in row's amount, if there is one, then click it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The Sales report is filtered to {Customer-A} only.
  • Step 5: It covers the twelve months the amount covers: from the 1st of the month eleven months back through today (for example Nov 1, 2025 to Oct 14, 2026 when tested on Oct 14, 2026).
  • Step 5: Its Totals row Subtotal equals the amount from step 3, to the cent.
  • Step 7: The $0.00 amount is plain text: the pointer does not change to a hand and clicking does nothing.
  • Step 8: The walk-in amount is plain text in the same way. If there is no walk-in row, write "walk-in row not reachable by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile), with SV-9582 (Story 10); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S6-R8a (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 4 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14) and S10-R8 (since version 41); read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=44&selectedPageVersions=45. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R8a: “In the At Risk Customers table, a customer's twelve-month revenue is a link that opens the Sales report filtered to that customer over the same twelve months the amount covers, so the report total equals the amount. A walk-in row, or an amount of $0.00, is plain text.”
  • S10-R8: “"Last 12 months" covers the same window on every tile and in every report the dashboard links to: from the first day of the month eleven months before the current month, through today, in the workplace's timezone. Example: on October 5, 2026 it covers November 1, 2025 to October 5, 2026.”
